[SWS_DM_00021] Direct failed qualification of counter-based events
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04125, RS_Diag_04068
⌈
If the
monitor
reports
kFailed
, the DM shall set the internal debounce counter to
the value
DiagEventDebounceCounterBased.counterFailedThreshold
and
process the event as
kFinallyDefective
.
⌋
